biotools.summary: Pythia is a tool for optimizing CRISPR integration, tagging, and editing strategies by leveraging deep-learning models and triplet base-pair repeat repair arms (trimologies). The tool facilitates integration of large cargo and protects targeted loci, and is available at pythia-editing.org.
